points.text: Companies periodically monitor their suppliers based on sustainability, questioning them on what help they require to establish themselves in the field of sustainability.

The European Union drafted legislation requiring companies to disclose their emissions on a quarterly basis for products imported into the EU, with a cap to be set for each product based on emissions data from January 2026 to December 2026.
ESG compliance may lead to cybersecurity being a byproduct, as companies focus on being sustainable and compliant with regulations to receive government credits and market benefits.
